name: EMI Analyzer
description: EMI and EMC review of the board open in the PCB Editor: layout checks for the causes of radiated emissions, ESD and immunity checks, a cable budget and an ESD transient simulation. A front end for the EMI Analyzer desktop app, which does the work on this computer; nothing is uploaded.

actions.name: EMI Analyzer
actions.description: Check this board for the causes of EMI and EMC failures
